Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission 
Law Division 
CMRRC Department 
Regulatory Section 

Notification  

Date: 30 October 2025 

No. 53.02.0000.000.201.22.0043.01.94.272.156In exercise of the powers 
conferred by section 33 of the Securities and Exchange Ordinance, 1969 (XVII 
of  1969),  after  prior  circulation,  the  Bangladesh  Securities  and  Exchange 
Commission hereby repeals the Margin Rules, 1999, namely: - 

1. Short  title  and  commencement.(1)  These  Rules  may  be  called  the 

Margin (Repeal) Rules, 2025. 

(2)  It  shall  come  into  force  on  the  effective  date  of  the  Bangladesh 

Securities and Exchange Commission (Margin) Rules, 2025. 

2. Repeal and savings.(1)The Magin Rules, 1999 is hereby repealed. 

(2) Notwithstanding the repeal of Margin Rules, 1999: 

(a)  anything  done  or  any  action  taken  under  or  in  pursuance  of  the 
Margin  Rules,  1999,  shall  continue  to  be  in  force  and  shall  have 
effect as if it done or taken under or in pursuance of the Bangladesh 
Securities and Exchange Commission (Margin) Rules, 2025; and
